stem: What is the nature of the line which includes the points \((-5,5)\), \((6,5)\), \((-3,5)\), \((0,5)\) ?
_why: All four points have y co-ordinate 5, so they lie on the line \(y = 5\), which is parallel to the X-axis at a distance of 5 units above it. It cannot pass through the origin, where \(y = 0\).

context: Choose the correct alternative answer for the following questions.
stem: Which of the points P\((-1,1)\), Q\((3,-4)\), R\((1,-1)\), S\((-2,-3)\), T\((-4,4)\) lie in the fourth quadrant ?
_why: The fourth quadrant needs \(x > 0\) and \(y < 0\). Only Q\((3,-4)\) and R\((1,-1)\) satisfy both; P and T lie in the second quadrant and S in the third.
